landing.title: Find what
landing.subtitle: Tell Sahayak about yourself in your own language. Understand every eligibility rule, collect the right documents, and apply with your consent — without decoding a government portal alone.
landing.ctaVoiceHint: Voice in English, Hindi or Marathi

how.title: From a sentence to a submitted application.
how.subtitle: Three calm steps, each one yours to confirm.

step1.title: Speak naturally
step1.description: Say what you study, where you live and your family income. Sahayak turns it into a profile you can edit.

step2.title: See your rights
step2.description: Every match comes with the exact rule that passed or failed, missing documents and a plain-language reason.

step3.title: Apply with consent
step3.description: The application agent fills the form. It stops at review and never submits until you explicitly confirm.

schemes.title: Schemes in the garden
schemes.subtitle: Fourteen verified central, Maharashtra, tribal, AICTE and CSR scholarships, editable as JSON and checked by deterministic rules.

scene.aria: Decorative 3D scheme garden with a floating voice orb and scholarship cards.

trust.title: Built for trust, not guesses.
trust.rules: Eligibility is decided by published rules, never by an AI guess.
trust.privacy: No Aadhaar storage. Uploaded files expire after 24 hours.
trust.audit: Every agent action is recorded in a masked audit log.

more.title: Your matched garden is personalised.
more.body: Build a profile to see eligibility, missing documents, and the exact rule behind every result.

portals.title: Check here. Apply on the official portal.
portals.subtitle: Sahayak explains eligibility from bundled rules. These government and CSR portals host the real application forms, OTR accounts and live deadlines.
portals.note: Each link opens an external website. Verify the scheme, deadline and documents there before applying.

profile.title: Start with your own words.
profile.subtitle: Speak or type in English, Hindi or Marathi. I will propose the details, and you decide what to keep.

voice.title: Talk to Sahayak
voice.hint: Try: “I am 19, from Pune, studying in a government college. My family income is two lakh and I scored 82 percent.”
voice.unsupported: Voice input is not supported here. Type below instead.
voice.transcriptPlaceholder: Your words will appear here, or type your profile in a sentence.
voice.guidePrompt: Say something like: I am 19 years old, I live in Pune, and I study in a government college. My family income is two lakh rupees and I scored 82 percent.

profile.extractedHint: Check each value. Amber fields had lower extraction confidence.

form.title: Your details
form.subtitle: Only what you save is used for matching. You can change everything.
form.saveFirst: Add a few details to see meaningful matches.
form.sampleNote: Sample data uses a fictional student, Riya Patil.
form.allSet: All details added. You can still change anything later.

profile.extractedApplied: These values are in the form. Review them and save when you are ready.

errors.income: Enter a valid annual income in rupees.

results.title: A garden of possibilities.
results.subtitle: Ranked by annual benefit, then deadline. Every colour and height has a reasoning you can read.

empty.title: Let’s build your profile first.
empty.body: A few details are enough to check every scheme in the catalogue.

results.noProfile: Complete your profile to check eligibility.
results.sceneHint: Select a result to see its details. The full list below has the same information.
results.contextPrompt: Explain why {{scheme}} is eligible or not eligible. Deadline: {{deadline}}. Conditions met: {{met}}. Missing or not met: {{missing}}. Give exact next steps.
results.noFilterMatches: No schemes in this filter. Try another one.

scheme.sourceNotice: This demo uses sample thresholds. Verify this scheme and its deadline on the official source before applying.
scheme.applyComing: The guided application flow is not enabled in this demo build yet. Use the official source above to apply.

quickAnswer.disabilityHint: Answer yes only if the disability is certified at 40% or more.

privacy.title: Your data belongs to you.
privacy.subtitle: Sahayak keeps the demo small on purpose: no Aadhaar numbers, no payment details, no hidden sharing.
privacy.whatBody: An anonymous signed session, your profile fields, and — when you use those features — uploaded documents and application records. Files live locally on this machine.
privacy.deleteBody: This removes your profile, uploaded documents, applications, audit entries and generated receipts for this anonymous session. It cannot be undone.
privacy.confirmBody: This action permanently deletes your Sahayak data on this machine.

expiry.title: 24-hour file expiry
expiry.body: Uploaded documents expire by default after 24 hours and are removed by a cleanup task.

noAadhaar.title: No Aadhaar storage
noAadhaar.body: We never ask for or store Aadhaar numbers. Sensitive values are masked in audit logs.

consent.title: Consent before submission
consent.body: The application agent cannot press Final Submit without a fresh consent token recorded by the backend.

assistant.title: Sahayak voice assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask about matches, documents, deadlines or this page.
assistant.groundedNote: From your profile and scheme JSON
assistant.handsFreeOn: Hands-free after each reply. Tap the mic to interrupt.
assistant.micHint: Tap the mic once. Then I keep listening after each reply.

replies.greeting: Hello, I am Sahayak. I can explain your matches, documents and deadlines from the scheme data on this page. Ask me a question, or tap the microphone.
replies.help: I can tell you which schemes you match, why a condition passed or failed, which documents are missing, and when each scheme closes. I can also read a page aloud and switch between English, Hindi and Marathi.
replies.thanks: You are welcome. What else would you like to know?
replies.stop: Stopped. Tap the microphone when you want to speak again.
replies.noProfile: I need a profile before I can check schemes. Say “go to my profile” and we can start there.
replies.noMatch: Your profile is ready, but I do not have your matches yet. Open your matches and I will read them.
replies.noSchemes: No scheme data is loaded right now. Check the backend and try again.
replies.eligibilityHead_one: You are eligible for one scheme: {{names}}.
replies.eligibilityNone: I did not find a fully eligible scheme yet.
replies.eligibilityFollowUp: Ask me about documents or deadlines for any of them.
replies.likelyLine: You may also qualify for {{names}} if a few details are confirmed.
replies.benefitLine: The potential benefit is about {{amount}} per year.
replies.documentsAll: You already have all required documents.
replies.documentsNoResult: Build your profile to check which documents are still missing.
replies.documentsNoMatch: Open your matches first and I can check your documents.
replies.documentsGeneric: These documents are missing for your matched schemes: {{documents}}.
replies.documentsNone: I do not see any missing documents for your matched schemes.
replies.deadlines: Your matched schemes close on these dates: {{items}}.
replies.deadlinesNone: I do not have deadlines yet. Build your profile and open your matches.
replies.schemeInfo: {{scheme}} is offered by {{authority}}. It gives up to {{amount}} per year. The deadline is {{date}}.
replies.schemeInfoNoStatus: Build your profile to see whether you qualify.
replies.schemeList: The schemes I can explain are {{names}}. Which one would you like?
replies.whyNoScheme: Which scheme should I explain? You can pick one of {{names}}.
replies.whyNoResult: I do not have an eligibility result for {{scheme}} yet. Open your matches first.
replies.whyNone: You meet every published condition for {{scheme}}.
replies.whyIntro_one: For {{scheme}}, one condition is not met. {{reasons}}
replies.ruleNoScheme: Which scheme do you mean? You can pick one of {{names}}.
replies.ruleNoRule: I could not find that condition for {{scheme}}.
replies.missingProfile: Your profile is {{percent}} percent complete. Still missing: {{fields}}.
replies.profileComplete: Your profile is complete. You can ask about your matches or documents.
replies.readHome: Sahayak helps you find scholarships, understand every rule, and apply with your consent. Start by saying: build my profile.
replies.readProfile: Your profile is {{percent}} percent complete. Still missing: {{fields}}.
replies.readResults: You are eligible for {{count}} schemes: {{names}}. The potential benefit is about {{amount}} per year.
replies.readResults_one: You are eligible for one scheme: {{names}}. The potential benefit is about {{amount}} per year.
replies.readResults_other: You are eligible for {{count}} schemes: {{names}}. The potential benefit is about {{amount}} per year.
replies.readResultsNone: You do not have a fully eligible scheme yet. {{likely}}
replies.readResultsEmpty: I do not have matches yet. Build your profile first.
replies.readScheme: {{scheme}}. {{description}} It gives up to {{amount}} per year. The deadline is {{date}}. You need these documents: {{documents}}.
replies.readSchemePrompt: Which scheme should I read? I can read {{names}}.
replies.readPrivacy: Your data belongs to you. Sahayak stores an anonymous session and your profile, and you can delete everything from the privacy page.
replies.readOther: I can read your matches or a scheme page. Open one and ask again.
replies.fallback: I am not sure I understood. I can explain matches, documents, deadlines, or read a page aloud. Try asking: what am I eligible for?
replies.nothingToRepeat: I have not said anything yet. Ask me about your matches, documents or deadlines.
replies.farewell: Goodbye. I will be here when you need me.
